detailed_descriptions.en: Tiny Flock is a beautifully realized, cosy physics-based puzzle game built exclusively for VR. Your mission is simple: guide your adorable wayward sheep to their inviting pasture utilizing the environment around to create safe passage. How you do it can be entirely up to you - but be careful, as where you lead they will follow - and the grass is not always greener! Each level is an amazing 3D diorama world where the game environment is fully interactive. Use any object available in any way imaginable to complete the task. Create paths and bridges, stack things, throw things, pull ropes and levers or even smash up objects to create a safe passage for your adorable sheep. How you do that is up to you as there is no set solution. All you have is physics, creativity, and the environment around you – plus a tiny flock of very patient, slightly wayward sheep! Whether you’re carefully engineering a structure or chaotically blowing a path through the level, Tiny Flock rewards curiosity and experimentation at every turn. With hand-tracking support, you’re not just playing the game - you’re reaching in and touching it. Key Features Herd your tiny flock through 21 beautifully hand-crafted diorama levels. Built exclusively for VR with full hand-tracking via Steam Link and pass-through support. A fully interactive world - if you can see it, you can interact with it - build bridges, smash objects, pull levers and guide your sheep to safety in your own way! Using a custom physics setup that gives an amazingly tactile, satisfying gaming experience unlike anything else in VR. Achievements and collectables for replayability and completionists. Original music soundtrack - a magnificent cello score to match the cosy puzzle atmosphere.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Tiny Flock is a beautifully realized, cosy physics-based puzzle game built exclusively for VR.

Your mission is simple: guide your adorable wayward sheep to their inviting pasture utilizing the environment around to create safe passage. How you do it can be entirely up to you - but be careful, as where you lead they will follow - and the grass is not always greener!

Each level is an amazing 3D diorama world where the game environment is fully interactive. Use any object available in any way imaginable to complete the task.

Create paths and bridges, stack things, throw things, pull ropes and levers or even smash up objects to create a safe passage for your adorable sheep. How you do that is up to you as there is no set solution. All you have is physics, creativity, and the environment around you – plus a tiny flock of very patient, slightly wayward sheep!

Whether you’re carefully engineering a structure or chaotically blowing a path through the level, Tiny Flock rewards curiosity and experimentation at every turn. With hand-tracking support, you’re not just playing the game - you’re reaching in and touching it.

Key Features

  • Herd your tiny flock through 21 beautifully hand-crafted diorama levels.

  • Built exclusively for VR with full hand-tracking via Steam Link and pass-through support.

  • A fully interactive world - if you can see it, you can interact with it - build bridges, smash objects, pull levers and guide your sheep to safety in your own way!

  • Using a custom physics setup that gives an amazingly tactile, satisfying gaming experience unlike anything else in VR.

  • Achievements and collectables for replayability and completionists.

  • Original music soundtrack - a magnificent cello score to match the cosy puzzle atmosphere.
